review_locator: PMCID:PMC3245201, Leukocyte ligands for endothelial selectins; PMCID:PMC3680630, E-selectin ligands as mechanosensitive receptors on neutrophils
primary_title: CD44 is a major E-selectin ligand on human hematopoietic progenitor cells; Complete identification of E-selectin ligands on neutrophils reveals distinct functions of PSGL-1, ESL-1, and CD44
decision_basis: The reviews identify CD44/HCELL as an E-selectin ligand and cite primary glycoform and loss-of-function studies showing CD44-dependent E-selectin binding, rolling, and hematopoietic-cell adhesion under flow.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD44/HCELL glycoform identity, sialylated/fucosylated N-glycans, species and cell-state differences, and E-selectin flow-adhesion context; no CD44 intracellular relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3245201, Leukocyte ligands for endothelial selectins; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: The E-selectin-ligand ESL-1 is a variant of a receptor for fibroblast growth factor; Complete identification of E-selectin ligands on neutrophils reveals distinct functions of PSGL-1, ESL-1, and CD44
decision_basis: The reviews identify ESL-1/GLG1 as an E-selectin-selective ligand and cite primary recombinant isolation, fucosylation, antibody-blocking, and neutrophil-loss studies supporting E-selectin binding and leukocyte adhesion.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ESL-1/GLG1 fucosylated N-glycan requirement, mouse-versus-human ligand differences, and selectin flow/rolling context; no FGFR signaling or intracellular ESL-1 relay is inferred.

primary_title: Smad7 binds to the adaptors TAB2 and TAB3 to block recruitment of the kinase TAK1 to the adaptor TRAF2
decision_basis: Primary study supports SMAD7-TAB2 association and inhibitory TGF-beta/TNF signalosome crosstalk.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TGF-beta-induced SMAD7, TAB2 adaptor, TNF-TRAF2-TAK1 and no-terminal-TF/no-SCI boundaries.

primary_title: Smad6 negatively regulates interleukin 1-receptor-Toll-like receptor signaling through direct interaction with the adaptor Pellino-1
decision_basis: Primary study supports SMAD6-Pellino1 association and inhibition of the IRAK1-Pellino1-TRAF6 inflammatory signalosome.
limitations_preserved: Preserve SMAD6 MH2/Pellino-1 and TGF-beta/BMP-to-IL-1/TLR inhibitory context; no direct receptor or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Notch post-translationally regulates beta-catenin protein in stem and progenitor cells
decision_basis: Primary study supports NOTCH1/NICD1-active beta-catenin complex association with Numb/lysosomal post-translational regulation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve membrane-bound Notch versus NICD, active beta-catenin, Numb/lysosomal and comparator-cell context; no terminal-TF/no-SCI inference.

primary_title: The notch intracellular domain can function as a coactivator for LEF-1
decision_basis: Primary GST-pulldown and mapping support NICD-LEF1 binding and beta-catenin-independent LEF-1 coactivation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NICD TAD/LEF-1 HMG interaction and noncanonical reporter context; no terminal-gene/no-SCI inference.

primary_title: beta-Catenin-Gli1 interaction regulates proliferation and tumor growth in medulloblastoma
decision_basis: Primary co-IP/PLA and stability assays support stabilized beta-catenin binding to GLI1 with sequestration/degradation and reduced Hedgehog output.
limitations_preserved: Preserve stabilized beta-catenin, GLI1 degradation and Ptch1+/- medulloblastoma context; no terminal-TF/no-SCI inference.
